The test image shows banana fruit fingers (pods) with dark brown/black necrotic tissue at the tips (distal/blossom ends). This is a pod disease.

Let me check the part index and a Cigar End Rot reference simultaneously.
Part index confirms pod narrows to: **Anthracnose** and **Cigar_End_Rot**. The Cigar End Rot reference shows very similar dark tip necrosis. Now I need 3 more views from different classes.
Anthracnose on pods shows scattered dark spots on the fruit body - very different from the test image's tip necrosis. Now viewing two more classes.

**Summary of evidence:**

- **Test image**: Pod disease - dark brown/black necrotic rot localized at the distal (blossom/tip) ends of green banana fingers, with dried floral remnants attached.
- **Cigar_End_Rot ref**: Shows identical tip necrosis at the ends of banana fingers - strong match.
- **Anthracnose ref**: Shows scattered small dark circular spots across the fruit body - does not match.
- **Bunchy_Top / Yellow_And_Black_Sigatoka**: Both are leaf diseases - irrelevant to this pod symptom.

The tip rot pattern is the hallmark of Cigar End Rot (named for the resemblance to a burned cigar tip). No other candidate fits.
